privacyBoundary: The exact private interview narrative is intentionally omitted. Only the non-sensitive owner correction and abstract failure mechanisms are recorded.

observedFailures.failure: The interviewer repeated semantically equivalent questions after a long thread.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: The planning calls retained only a short tail of recent conversation, so earlier answered observer-view and scope questions fell outside the model-visible window and became eligible to be asked again.

observedFailures.failure: The progress display remained at zero throughout a long active thread.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: Coverage aggregation was updated only after participant adjudication of a completed pattern, so substantial evidence collected inside an unsettled thread was invisible to the participant-facing progress calculation.

observedFailures.failure: The thread ended without a new final synthesis after extensive refinement.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: The refinement schema explicitly prohibited surface_hypothesis, so once refinement began it could only ask more questions or announce that no useful question remained; it could not produce an updated synthesis for participant judgment.

observedFailures.failure: Accepting the stale synthesis failed because its grounding referenced a fact the participant had corrected later in the same thread.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: A tentative proposal was committed into the v2 record before participant adjudication while later refinement could supersede its supporting facts. The proposal therefore remained structurally active after its evidence became non-operative.

observedFailures.failure: The owner reasonably feared the entire interview had been lost after the server-side flow failed.
observedFailures.supportedMechanism: The development app kept its hidden ledger in process memory and had no browser-local recovery copy of visible turns. A deployment restart or invalid session therefore had no participant-controlled recovery artifact.

logicLessons: A long adaptive interview needs durable semantic memory of what has already been asked and answered; a sliding context tail is not enough when repetition itself is a failure mode.
Participant-facing progress must update from evidence gathered during the active thread, not only after final adjudication.
A refinement state that can continue asking questions must also have a lawful path to emit the revised synthesis that ends refinement.

Do not commit a tentative proposal into the durable semantic record before participant judgment if later refinement can invalidate its evidence; keep the working synthesis ephemeral until adjudication or provide explicit proposal-supersession semantics.
An in-memory development interview needs participant-controlled local recovery of visible turns so infrastructure restarts do not convert product bugs into data loss.
